negative_findings.description: No Reuters article on Slovenian banking surfaced directly in search results despite Reuters being named in the cell scope; only third-party references and aggregator restatements appeared.

negative_findings.description: Bloomberg, SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, STA wire and the Payment Yearbooks all gate their substantive content; only headlines and ledes are openly retrievable.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: A monitoring design that relies only on free sources will see event headlines but not the detail; budget for at least one regional wire subscription (SeeNews or bne) if depth is required.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated careers/vacancy URLs were confirmed in this pass for several relevant SI actors: Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Sberbank-successor entities, Banka Slovenije (central bank), and domestic fintechs/e-money issuers (e.g. mBills, Flik participants).

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language equivalents were found in this pass for vendor/programme jargon that job ads typically carry in English ('core banking migration', 'instant payments', 'ISO 20022', 'PSD2/PSD3 readiness'); SI ads appear to use the English terms verbatim.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-in-Slovenian is the working register for bank IT ads; SL-only queries will under-recall technical roles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must mix SL job-ad framing words with English technical tokens, or half the signal is invisible.

negative_findings.description: Job ads on SI portals and employer sites expire and are deleted, and no public archive of expired SI bank vacancies was identified.

negative_findings.description: The seed query assumed an event named 'Dnevi slovenskih bančnikov' (plural 'Days'). Slovenian sources consistently show the singular 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov' (Slovenian Bankers' Day), an annual ZBS event, alongside a separate spring 'bančna konferenca'. No source found uses the plural form.
negative_findings.result_summary: Correct local-language term is 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov'; queries using the plural return unrelated events (Finančni dnevi, Kapitalski dnevi, Dnevi slovenske informatike).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection keyed on the wrong event name would miss the single most important gathering in this cell and pull in unrelated accountancy conferences.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found that Bankart (the national card/ATM processor, NLB Group) runs or publishes its own conference, user-group meeting or presentation archive. Searches combining Bankart with konferenca/posvet/dogodek returned only the company's own product pages and unrelated Portorož conferences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bankart appears to speak at third-party events (ZBS posvet o kartičnem poslovanju is the likely venue) rather than hosting an indexed event archive of its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The domestic processor's roadmap statements must be sought inside ZBS posvet agendas and regional events (Money Motion), not on bankart.si.

negative_findings.description: No public slide-deck / presentation archive was located for any Slovenian banking conference in this pass. ZBS posvet pages appear to expose agendas and registration but not downloadable decks; DSI publishes a 'zbornik' (proceedings) which is the closest equivalent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Presentation content is largely non-public; recordings (ZBS YouTube) and proceedings (DSI zbornik) are the viable substitutes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed slide decks would be obtainable; collection design should instead prioritise agendas, speaker lists, video and proceedings.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian 'bančnik leta' (banker of the year) award run by ZBS or the Bank of Slovenia was found. The closest personal recognitions are the general 'Manager leta' award (Združenje Manager) and Bank of Slovenia research awards.
negative_findings.result_summary: Person-level banking awards in Slovenia appear to be general management awards, not sector-specific.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a collector for an award that does not exist; redirects attention to institution-level awards (Moje finance, WEBSI, Global Finance, Euromoney).

negative_findings.description: The Bančni vestnik archive is behind a login ('Prijava') at bv.zbs-giz.si and info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv, though individual PDFs (notably the English special issues) are directly linked and reachable. Not treated as dead — treated as partially gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Full-text archive requires subscription; bibliography indexes and some PDFs appear open.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if conference papers in Bančni vestnik are to be systematically collected.

negative_findings.description: The canonical Sibos agenda/session-archive URL (sibos.com) was not directly confirmed in this pass; the Sibos entry is recorded from category knowledge plus third-party coverage, with a Wikipedia URL as placeholder rather than an invented agenda link.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sibos is included at low confidence and low priority pending a verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated URL entering the registry while preserving the lead.

negative_findings.description: The GZS and Bizi event-calendar root URLs (gzs.si/Dogodki/, bizi.si/dogodki/) are inferred from the deep event URLs actually returned by search; only the deep URLs were observed. Flagged so the verification pass checks the roots rather than assuming them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep event URLs observed; index roots inferred, not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Root URLs drive the crawl seed list; an inferred root that 404s would silently disable a collector.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated press release or corporate announcement from Tuš (Engrotuš) about introducing a new payment acceptance method or in-app payment was found in either Slovenian or English searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only loyalty-programme descriptions and third-party market overviews; the retailer's own newsroom path was not surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a gap in grocery-acceptance coverage for the third-largest chain, so acceptance events at Tuš may be detected only via national media rather than at source.

negative_findings.description: The seed term 'PS Moneta' did not resolve to any current Pošta Slovenije payment product in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced 'denarne storitve' and annual reports but nothing named Moneta at Pošta Slovenije; 'Moneta' historically denotes a Mobitel/Telekom carrier-billing brand, not a postal product.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using 'PS Moneta' as a standing query term would produce false negatives; the correct local terms for postal payment coverage are 'denarne storitve' and 'plačilni promet', and Moneta queries should be aimed at Telekom Slovenije instead.

negative_findings.description: No DARS (motorway operator) source on e-vignette or toll payment-instrument changes was surfaced despite an explicit Slovenian-language query.
negative_findings.result_summary: The parking/toll query returned only EasyPark and municipal parking results; no dars.si or evinjeta.dars.si material appeared.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tolling and e-vignette sales are a very large recurring card-acceptance channel in Slovenia and are currently uncovered in this cell.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language source was found for mimovrste=) (a leading Slovenian online retailer) regarding payment-provider integration or new payment methods.
negative_findings.result_summary: The e-commerce PSP query returned Big Bang material and generic EU guidance instead; mimovrste's own newsroom or payment pages did not surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: mimovrste is one of the highest-volume domestic e-commerce merchants; missing it weakens acceptance-side coverage of online payments.

negative_findings.description: The Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije primary domain (tzslo.si) and the AJPES JOLP annual-report entry point were inferred from organisational knowledge rather than confirmed by a fetch in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned only third-party profiles (Bizi, Facebook, media tag pages) for the chamber; AJPES did not appear in any result set for the queries run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Both are load-bearing pointer sources for this cell; their exact entry URLs must be confirmed by the deterministic liveness pass before being wired into collection.

negative_findings.description: Slovenia appears to have no dedicated statutory banking ombudsman (a 'bančni varuh'). Searches in Slovene surfaced only the ZBS-run IRPS ADR scheme and Banka Slovenije's supervisory complaint channel; the Human Rights Ombudsman is generalist and archive material discusses proposals for sectoral ombudsmen rather than an existing one.
negative_findings.result_summary: ADR for banking disputes is industry-run (ZBS) and its opinions are reportedly non-binding on banks, which limits the enforcement weight of that channel's outputs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Complaint-outcome data is therefore fragmented across ZBS, Banka Slovenije and courts; no single authoritative complaints register exists to track institution-level failure rates.

negative_findings.description: IP-RS inspection decisions (inšpekcijske odločbe) in the data-protection field are reportedly not routinely published on the DPA website due to sensitivity, despite being among the most-requested FOI items.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public register of named DPA enforcement decisions against Slovenian banks/PSPs was found; only opinions (mnenja) and an OPSI 'praksa' dataset were located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Institution-level DPA enforcement against banks will require FOI (ZDIJZ) requests or third-party aggregators, so automated monitoring alone will under-count enforcement events.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'AVP/court rulings'. In Slovenia AVP is the Agencija za varnost prometa (road-traffic safety agency), which has no banking or payments remit; no financial-sector body with that acronym was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a brief error; substituted the actual court-ruling sources (sodnapraksa.si, sodisce.si) and the actual sectoral supervisors (Banka Slovenije, AZN, ATVP).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated or misdirected source entry and corrects the actor map for downstream runs.

negative_findings.description: No centralised Slovenian outage/incident register for payment systems was found. Outage evidence is scattered across per-bank 'obvestila za stranke' pages and news reports; Bankart does not appear to publish a public status page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outage tracking must be assembled from many per-institution pages plus media monitoring.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Correlating multi-bank outages to shared processors (Bankart) will depend on inference from timestamps rather than an authoritative feed.

negative_findings.description: No English-language equivalent was found for most Slovene complaint/fraud sources; ZBS's ADR page has an /en/ path but consumer-protection, police and DPA material is Slovene-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss essentially the entire cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovene-language crawling and keyword lists are mandatory for this cell, not optional.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the NLB Group press-release or investor-news listings; the pages use a year filter plus a 'Show more' pagination control.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must rely on scheduled HTML polling and pagination handling rather than a feed subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Raises collection cost and latency risk for the highest-value announcement stream; a missed poll can silently skip a disclosure.

negative_findings.description: The specific London Stock Exchange instrument/news page for NLB's GDR line (symbol NLB) was not resolved to an exact URL in this pass; only the LSE root and a third-party Investegate announcement were confirmed as leads.
negative_findings.result_summary: GDR-side RNS stream identified conceptually and via a mirror, but no confirmed canonical LSE URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The UK-regulated feed carries TR-1 major-holdings notices and ATA notices that may not appear on nlbgroup.com; leaving it unresolved risks a disclosure blind spot.

negative_findings.description: SEOnet (seonet.ljse.si) was identified as the statutory disclosure venue but its NLB-specific issuer announcement listing URL was not captured; the site is an ASP.NET application with form-driven filtering and file.aspx?AttachmentID= downloads.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed as the authoritative venue; per-issuer deep link and scrape mechanics still to be worked out.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SEOnet is the legally authoritative record; a collector that cannot filter by issuer will either over-collect the whole market or miss NLB filings.

negative_findings.description: No public archive of NLB earnings-call transcripts (as text) was located; the event pages point to webcasts/replays rather than transcripts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Q&A content appears to exist only as audio/video, not searchable text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Management Q&A is where unscripted IT/vendor/integration detail surfaces; without transcripts this requires ASR processing rather than text collection.

negative_findings.description: Slovenian securities regulator ATVP and the central securities depository KDD were noted as adjacent official disclosure actors but were not searched in this cell, since this cell is scoped to NLB's own IR machine.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deliberately not covered here; flagged so another cell can pick them up.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATVP/KDD hold takeover-bid filings and shareholder-register data that complement issuer self-disclosure.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovenian for investor-relations pages ('odnosi z vlagatelji', 'za vlagatelje') for the foreign-owned subsidiaries in this cell — OTP banka SI, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, UniCredit Banka Slovenija, Addiko SI, Sparkasse, Gorenjska banka.
negative_findings.result_summary: None of them operates an IR page in the listed-issuer sense. Their disclosure surface is a documents/reports page plus a press room. Only Delavska hranilnica and DBS maintain investor-style sections, because they have dispersed domestic shareholders / listed debt.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume IR pages, earnings calls, or transcripts for this cell. Cadence is annual (report) + episodic (press), with the exception of UniCredit SI's quarterly razkritja and Addiko's listed parent.

negative_findings.description: Checked SKB banka d.d. Ljubljana against the Bank of Slovenia supervised-entity register.
negative_findings.result_summary: SKB was removed from the register on 22.8.2024 following its merger into OTP banka d.d. The skb.si PDF archive still resolves in search results but is a legacy asset with no new filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tracking SKB as a live source will yield permanent silence and may be misread as a dead-site failure. It should be archived once and reclassified as historical; forward coverage rolls into OTP banka d.d.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a standalone Pillar 3 / CRR Part 8 document for SKB banka and for Gorenjska banka in Slovenian ('razkritja', 'razkritja dodatnih informacij').
negative_findings.result_summary: For SKB no separate Pillar 3 PDF surfaced — disclosures appear folded into the annual report. For Gorenjska banka a 'dodatna-razkritja' PDF exists but the search result was an older (2021-path) file; the current-year equivalent was not directly observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 granularity varies by issuer in this cell; a uniform Pillar-3-first collection rule would fail. Some banks require parsing the annual report to reach the same tables.

negative_findings.description: Deželna banka Slovenije and Delavska hranilnica each returned two parallel URL generations/domains for the same content (dbs.si /o-nas/ vs /o-banki/; dh.si vs delavska-hranilnica.si).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both variants appear in current search results; which is canonical was not determined and is not claimed here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors keyed to the non-canonical path risk silent 404s that look like source death. Canonicalisation should be resolved in the deterministic verification pass, not assumed.

negative_findings.description: The cell rationale predicts these private/foreign-owned banks bypass public procurement portals; no attempt within this workstream (A1) surfaced any tender-portal presence for them.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public tender surface identified for any bank in this cell; vendor/technology signals must be inferred from press releases, annual report narrative sections, and parent-group presentations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that press rooms and annual reports carry disproportionate weight for this cell and should be collected in full text, not just headline metrics.

negative_findings.description: Searches for Slovenia-specific press releases from Nexi (Nexi Slovenija d.o.o.) returned only company-register and credit-rating aggregator pages — no Slovenian-language corporate newsroom for the local entity surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nexi Slovenija appears to have no local press channel; announcements presumably flow only through Nexi Group (Italy) in English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Slovenia-specific processing wins or restructurings at the second-largest local processor may be invisible unless group IR is monitored with full-text country filtering, or AJPES filings are read annually.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language Mastercard or Visa press release / newsroom page was located despite a local-language query using 'sporočilo za javnost'. Results were dominated by Slovenian banks' card terms and consumer FAQ pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card scheme country announcements for Slovenia were not found on a local newsroom in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief expects card scheme country announcements; if none exist locally, coverage must be achieved via the schemes' global newsrooms with Slovenia keyword filters, which is lower-recall.

negative_findings.description: Bankart's 'Aktualno' newsroom lists only five items spanning 2020-2026, with no visible pagination or archive, and one item is titled generically 'SPOROČILO ZA JAVNOST' (26.3.2025).
negative_findings.result_summary: Official Bankart announcement volume is very low (roughly 1-2 items per year).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The processor at the centre of this cell does not use press releases as its main disclosure channel — annual reports, scheme rulebooks and merchant documentation carry far more signal, and the collection design must weight them accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Bankart annual reports and payment-system public disclosure documents were found only as direct wp-content PDF URLs surfaced by search engines; they are not linked from the current site navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: No stable annual-report index page on bankart.si was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler following site navigation alone would miss the single richest quantitative source in this cell; discovery must combine sitemap/upload-path enumeration with AJPES.

negative_findings.description: Several URLs in this slice were assembled from search-result snippets rather than fetched in this pass (Nexi Group media index, Mastercard SI root, flik.si root, ECB TIPS index, EPC register, ZBS root, AJPES root, BSI National Payments Council index).
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores but liveness is explicitly not asserted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must resolve these; a 403 or timeout on any of them should be treated as bot defence, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: The Bank of Slovenia 'Poročilo o plačilnih in poravnalnih sistemih' 2021 edition was found on a third-party mirror (findinfo.si) rather than at a canonical bsi.si permalink.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical publication landing page for this annual report series was not pinned down.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-term monitoring needs the canonical bsi.si index; relying on a mirror risks silent breakage and version ambiguity.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian-language newsroom or press-release archive was located for mBills (the Slovenian mobile-wallet/mobile-payments product). Searches returned no company news channel for it.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language search combining mBills with Leanpay and Paywiser returned nothing on mBills; it may only be covered via its parent/bank-partner channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The domestic mobile-wallet segment is a core part of this cell; without a direct channel it must be tracked indirectly via its owning entity's disclosures and national media, which delays signal.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenia-specific structured funding-round database (rounds, amounts, investors) for fintech/payments startups was found in either language during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: startup.si offers an investment-tagged news stream and an investor directory, but not a structured round-level dataset; searches surfaced only journalistic rankings of best-funded startups.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Funding rounds are the primary disclosure channel for unlicensed wallet/BNPL startups; without a structured source, round tracking depends on media monitoring with unknown recall.

negative_findings.description: A directly linked, standalone ATVP page listing MiCA/CASP authorisations for Slovenia was not confirmed; results pointed to ATVP's investment-services register, ATVP MiCA guidance material, and the ESMA interim/central register accessed via ATVP.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language search for the ATVP crypto register returned the investment-services register and a MiCA leaflet PDF, plus media reporting that 24 providers may operate in Slovenia and that ATVP issued its first MiCA licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Slovenian CASP population must currently be derived from the ESMA register filtered to SI rather than a national list, adding a dependency and possible lag.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all URLs come from search-result metadata and site-structure inference and are supplied with confidence scores only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery pass was search-driven; deterministic verification is left to the downstream pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some deep paths (e.g. section index URLs assembled from article URLs) may redirect or 404 and should be treated as unverified rather than dead.

negative_findings.description: Attempted the obvious Slovenian press-release path on the Halcom corporate site, https://www.halcom.com/sl/novice/ — returned HTTP 404. Halcom articles do exist directly under /sl/<slug>/ (e.g. the 30-years anniversary piece), so the news index lives at some other path.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on the guessed news index; individual article URLs confirmed to exist under /sl/. This is an unverified path hypothesis, not evidence the section is dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Halcom is the single most important e-banking vendor in the cell; the collector needs the correct news index (via sitemap.xml or on-site navigation) before any automated monitoring is set up.

negative_findings.description: The seed-named vendor 'Result d.o.o.' could not be resolved to a banking-technology supplier. Slovenian-language searching returned only unrelated banking pages; 'result' is a highly noisy term in both sl and en.
negative_findings.result_summary: No vendor website, reference page or bank project attributable to a 'Result d.o.o.' in Slovenian banking IT was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either the actor name is imprecise, refers to a foreign entity (e.g. Result d.o.o. in Croatia/Serbia), or it has been renamed/absorbed. It must be resolved via AJPES/Bizi entity search before further scouting, and treated as a noisy term.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovenian for ATM supplier contracts (NCR, Diebold Nixdorf, Wincor Nixdorf) with Slovenian banks produced no contract announcements, only general market descriptions (three ATM brands present: Wincor Nixdorf, NCR, Diebold) and one Wikipedia/hobby page.
negative_findings.result_summary: No press release or contract notice naming a Slovenian bank's ATM supplier was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: hardware supply to private Slovenian banks is entirely undisclosed. Vendor-side signals (installer/maintainer job ads, Euronet/Payten pages, Diebold SEC filings, ATM chassis branding in bank photos) will have to substitute for contract records.

negative_findings.description: Mikrografija's references page was fetched in full: it carries short logo testimonials only (Delavska hranilnica is the sole financial-sector name), not case studies with dates, scope or values.
negative_findings.result_summary: One usable bank-vendor pairing; no project detail, no dates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for a whole class of small Slovenian vendors: reference pages yield the 'who', almost never the 'what/when/how much'. Depth must come from the press wire or trade press.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language corporate or reference presence was located for Endava in the Slovenian banking context; the local-language query returned only OTP/NKBM merger coverage. Slovenian-language search terms for 'nearshore delivery centre' style SI vendors were not productive.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endava's Slovenian banking footprint remains unevidenced in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed named Endava/local SIs; either they operate through regional (RO/RS/HR) entities with English-only communications, or they are not materially present in SI banking. Needs an en-language pass against endava.com client stories filtered for Slovenia.

negative_findings.description: The English-language generic query for Slovenian core-banking customer references returned only global vendor listicles (Temenos, Mambu, Thought Machine, FIS, Finastra, Oracle FLEXCUBE) and SEO comparison blogs with zero Slovenian content.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only search is structurally unable to reach this cell; the Slovenian query for the identical concept immediately surfaced HRC/Hibis and the Deželna banka migration.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Empirically confirms that local-language search is mandatory here, and that English-language listicle domains should be down-weighted or blocked in the collector to avoid SEO noise.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a dedicated public-procurement section on Banka Slovenije's own site (bsi.si) in Slovenian.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone 'javna naročila' section surfaced on bsi.si; the FOI catalogue indicates all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si instead. Only a numismatic products invitation was found on bsi.si itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the collector must treat enarocanje.si/TED as the single route for central-bank tenders rather than expecting an issuer-side feed.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both sl and en for concrete Slovenian contract-award notices for banking/payment-system services or payment terminals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-engine results returned only portal-level and legal/explanatory pages, no individual banking or payments award notice. Notice-level detail appears to live behind the portals' own search forms, which general web search does not index well.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signals that keyword web search is inadequate for this cell — collection must go through the portals' native search/API (enarocanje.si forms, e-JN listing, TED Search API with CPV filters), not through search engines.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a public, bulk-exportable interface to UJP JN Plačila (statutory monthly reporting of executed public-procurement payments since 1 Jan 2023).
negative_findings.result_summary: Two entry points found (jnplacila.ujp.gov.si and jnplacila.si) but whether a public search/export exists for third parties, versus authority-only login, was not established in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is potentially the single richest quantitative feed in the cell; its access mode must be resolved before the collection design is fixed. Not recorded as unavailable — only as unverified.

negative_findings.description: KPK press release regarding data quality in the relaunched Erar application.
negative_findings.result_summary: KPK publicly stated it had not been informed of incorrect data in the UJP database before the new Erar went live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Erar figures for public-sector payments should be treated as indicative and cross-checked against UJP JN Plačila or the underlying contract before any number is quoted as fact.

negative_findings.description: Checked whether state-owned commercial banking stakes give a separate procurement route.
negative_findings.result_summary: SDH reports on state capital investments in aggregate; individual portfolio banks are private-law entities whose procurement is generally not on the public portal unless they qualify as contracting authorities. No portal-side evidence found either way in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the collector from assuming state-linked commercial banks will appear as naročniki on enarocanje.si; their signal must come from the private-bank cell instead, with SDH as the ownership bridge.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech or payments-industry association was found. Searches in Slovene for a 'slovensko fintech združenje' / 'združenje za plačilne storitve' returned only blockchain/crypto bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Blockchain Think Tank Slovenija) and general chambers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenia appears to lack a standalone fintech/PSP trade association; the function is split between ZBS (banks), GZS/ZIT (ICT vendors) and DLT communities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a single fintech member directory for SI; PSP/EMI population must be reconstructed from the Banka Slovenije register plus GZS/ZIT member lists.

negative_findings.description: Bančni vestnik full texts sit behind a login ('Prijava') and a password-protected e-archive; only metadata, article titles and some legacy items appear openly reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Journal is high value but gated; open crawling would capture only TOC-level data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget for a subscription or library access, or the richest SI-language banking commentary layer stays out of reach.

negative_findings.description: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije places its substantive trade-legislation and T-Informacije content in a member-only area (a registration/firewall path was visible in results).
negative_findings.result_summary: Merchant-side positions on card fees are likely produced but not publicly readable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The acquiring/interchange debate from the merchant perspective may be systematically under-collected without membership.

negative_findings.description: The ZBS members page renders members as logo images and, on fetch, showed no per-member hyperlinks; the transcribed names included at least one likely OCR/rendering artefact ('Lonza Bank', not a known Slovenian bank).
negative_findings.result_summary: Member names cannot be reliably extracted from that page alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any actor list derived from this page must be reconciled against the Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register before use; unreconciled names risk fabricated actors.

negative_findings.description: GZS/ZIT membership page and the GZS member register were identified by URL but their actual member enumerations were not read in this pass; ZIT board composition was only partially visible via search snippets (and the leadership names surfaced were dated ~2019).
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor-side membership data is located but not yet extracted or date-verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor mapping for the SI market remains incomplete until those pages are fetched directly.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of an RSS/Atom feed or machine-readable API on any of the association sites examined (ZBS, GZS, TZS); the ZBS press listing offers only category and year filters.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection will have to rely on HTML crawling rather than feeds.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects collector design and polling cost for the A1 workstream.

negative_findings.description: Slovene-language searching for press reports of banks selecting IT/payments vendors ('banka izbrala ponudnika informacijske rešitve', 'javno naročilo') returned no journalistic article naming a bank-vendor award; results drifted to Banka Slovenije corporate pages and the e-JN procurement portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero press hits; procurement portal ejn.gov.si surfaced instead as a non-press primary route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-selection intelligence for this cell may be structurally weak — commercial banks are not contracting authorities under public-procurement law, so awards are not gazetted and the press only reports them when a vendor issues a PR. Expect to rely on vendor press releases and Monitor.si rather than daily press.

negative_findings.description: The two highest-value outlets in this cell — Finance.si and the STA wire — are both subscription-gated, and Bančni vestnik full issues sit behind a login ('Prijava' appears in page titles).
negative_findings.result_summary: Headline/teaser layers appear public; full text is not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design based purely on open crawling will capture the existence of stories but not their specifics, which is exactly where this cell's value lies. Budget for licences or plan a headline-trigger + manual-read workflow.

negative_findings.description: Section URLs for Dnevnik's business desk (https://www.dnevnik.si/posel) and the STAkrog portal (https://krog.sta.si/) were inferred from search-result descriptions rather than confirmed by fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outlet existence is well evidenced; exact slugs are not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler seeded with an unconfirmed slug will silently return nothing; these two need slug resolution in the verification pass before they count as covered.

negative_findings.description: Slovene banking queries repeatedly pull Banka Slovenije, ECB and even Slovak (National Bank of Slovakia) results — the SI/SK confusion is a persistent noise source in English-language querying.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple searches returned Slovakia-related entities and central-bank pages instead of press coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must anchor on Slovene-language tokens and .si domains; English 'Slovenia bank' queries are unreliable and cross-contaminate with Slovakia.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian AML supervisor Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (Office for Money Laundering Prevention) and the Ministry of Finance were not searched in this pass, although both publish binding guidance affecting banks and PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl-language queries for 'Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja letno poročilo' and 'Ministrstvo za finance finančni sistem plačilne storitve' and classify their publication hubs.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian significant banks are supervised by the ECB/SSM and appear in EBA/ESMA/EIOPA EU-level registers (credit institutions register, payment institutions register under PSD2, ESMA prospectus register). These EU pointers were not enumerated here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over ECB SSM supervised-entities list, EBA credit-institutions and PSD2 registers, and ESMA registers, filtered to SI.

coverage_gaps.description: Banka Slovenije's statistical data warehouse / time-series download interface (beyond the HTML statistics landing pages) was not identified; whether an SDMX or bulk-download endpoint exists for payment statistics is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe bsi.si statistics section and the ECB SDW/Data Portal for SI payment-statistics series to enable numeric time-series collection instead of PDF scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: a-tvp.si appears bot-defended (403), so its registers, enforcement decisions and prospectus pages are currently uncollectable with a plain HTTP client.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test a headless-browser fetch path with realistic headers and rate limits against a-tvp.si before treating any of its pages as dead; record robots.txt terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth of BS press releases and ATVP enforcement listings was not established (how far back pagination goes, whether older items are retired).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe deep pagination and consider Wayback Machine backfill for pre-existing history on bsi.si/mediji/objave and a-tvp.si enforcement lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Deep links for the LJSE financial calendar and for per-issuer SEOnet archive pages were not pinned down; only homepage/sitemap entry points are recorded.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://ljse.si/en/sitemap/959 and one issuer instrument page (e.g. ISIN SI0021117344) to map the canonical URL patterns before building the crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: Most Slovenian payment-services firms and POS/IT suppliers to banks are unlisted d.o.o. entities whose only public artefact is the AJPES annual report; there is no press-release or IR stream for them in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with a media/procurement cell; and build the SKD-code-driven entity list (64.19, 64.99, 66.19, 62.01, 62.09, 47.4x) from ePRS/OPSI to make AJPES coverage systematic.

coverage_gaps.description: Free JOLP access covers only the last five business years; longer time series for trend analysis are not obtainable through the public interface.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope whether five years suffices; if not, price the AJPES bulk/historical channel or accept a commercial aggregator (e.g. Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet Slovenia) as a fallback — not yet scouted in this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial Slovenian credit/company-data aggregators that resell AJPES filings (bonitete providers) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'bonitetna ocena', 'bonitete podjetij', 'AJPES bonitete', 'GVIN', 'Bisnode Slovenija' to assess the paid aggregator tier.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched to confirm reachability; all entries rest on search-result evidence and observed URL patterns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over all example_urls, paying particular attention to oam.si, the bsi.si PDF links and the LJSE UserDocsImages PDF paths (which carry query-string version markers that may rotate).

coverage_gaps.description: No verified English IR/press-release endpoints for OTP Slovenija (post-NKBM/SKB merger), Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska Banka, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica or the processor Bankart.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated per-issuer pass in sl and en on each institution's site (terms: 'sporočila za javnost', 'za medije', 'letno poročilo', 'vlagatelji'), and record whether an English mirror exists and how complete it is relative to the Slovenian version.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is by definition the English layer, but the pass confirmed that English renderings are systematically partial (SEOnet legal caveat; SL-only investor news pages on nlbgroup.com/si-sl).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the monitor as SL-primary with EN as a discovery/cross-check channel: crawl SL and EN versions of the same issuer paths and diff them to produce an explicit 'untranslated disclosures' queue.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional aggregators were sampled but their Slovenia-specific banking cadence (items per month, lag versus the SL original) was not measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a two-week baseline capture across SeeNews Slovenia, bne IntelliNews, STA English and The Slovenia Times, logging publication timestamps against the corresponding SEOnet/issuer release times to quantify translation lag.

coverage_gaps.description: Rating agencies were only partly covered: S&P and Fitch actions on Slovenian banks were seen through press restatements, and Moody's was not covered at all in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register free accounts on Fitch, S&P Global Ratings and Moody's, identify the Slovenian bank issuer pages, and add them as direct English primary sources for the ratings topic.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level supervisory and statistical publishers that render Slovenian bank data in English (ECB SSM, EBA transparency exercise/risk dashboard, ECB payments statistics) were not enumerated in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ECB/SSM press and EBA data hubs as a separate sub-cell; they are the most reliable English quantitative layer for Slovenian banks and require no translation.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller Slovenian banks and savings banks (SKB/OTP-merged entities, Gorenjska banka/AIK, Addiko Bank Slovenia, Delavska hranilnica, Sparkasse) were not individually checked for rating-agency coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run per-issuer searches combining each bank's official name with 'bonitetna ocena' and 'rating' to map which second-tier banks are rated at all.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank annual-report auditor's opinions (revizorjevo mnenje / revizijsko poročilo) inside Slovenian bank annual reports were not harvested, nor was the mapping of which Big Four firm audits which Slovenian bank.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the auditor block and key audit matters from each bank's latest annual report PDF and cross-check against ANR registers and Big Four transparency reports.

coverage_gaps.description: IT/operational and cyber risk assessments of Slovenian banks (DORA readiness, ICT risk in SREP, ECB cyber stress test results with a Slovenia line) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated queries on ECB DORA/ICT-risk supervisory outputs and EBA ICT risk reporting filtered for Slovenia, plus Big Four DORA advisory material aimed at the SI market.

coverage_gaps.description: Domestic academic/think-tank assessors of the banking sector (University of Ljubljana Faculty of Economics, IMAD/UMAR, Bank Association of Slovenia analyses) were not covered as third-party analysts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a query pass for 'Združenje bank Slovenije analiza', 'UMAR bančni sektor', and EF UL research on Slovenian banking.

coverage_gaps.description: Licensed terminal/aggregator routes to agency research (Bloomberg, LSEG, Alacra, CBonds) were only glimpsed via alacrastore.com search hits and not assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess Alacra/CBonds per-report purchase pricing as a cheaper alternative to full agency subscriptions for occasional Slovenian bank reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers endpoints missing for Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Banka Slovenije, Sparkasse/Steiermärkische SI, and SI savings banks (hranilnice).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated SL pass per actor: '<bank> kariera', '<bank> zaposlitev', '<bank> prosta delovna mesta', plus site: queries on each .si domain; register each found endpoint as a direct source.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment/fintech vendors and integrators serving SI banks (beyond Halcom and Bankart) are unmapped — e.g. Comtrade, Marand, Endava/Adacta-type integrators, e-money and PSP licensees registered with Banka Slovenije.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference the Banka Slovenije register of payment institutions/e-money issuers with job-portal employer pages, then add each vendor's careers page as a source; vendor hiring is a leading indicator of bank projects.

coverage_gaps.description: No archiving/snapshot strategy exists for ephemeral ads, and no check was made for RSS/JSON feeds or an API on ZRSZ, Optius or Zaposlitev.net.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe for RSS/XML feeds (ZRSZ RSS is referenced on its site) and stable pagination URLs; store full ad HTML + text at first sighting with first_seen/last_seen timestamps.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — the best source for named stacks, seniority and headcount growth — is ToS/login-restricted, leaving no compliant automated route.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope a licensed labour-market data provider covering SI, or define a manual weekly analyst review protocol with saved searches and structured note capture.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent hiring-signal channels were not explored: student-work agencies (študentski servis) which banks use for pilot teams, procurement/consulting-body-shop tenders, and internship/scholarship programmes (štipendije) that flag multi-year capability plans.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a discovery pass over študentsko delo portals and bank scholarship/internship pages in SL; these leak intent even earlier than permanent-role ads.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage relied largely on LinkedIn; international-group career portals (UniCredit group, Intesa Sanpaolo group, OTP group, Addiko group) that carry SI-located requisitions in EN were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map each parent group's global careers portal and filter by location=Slovenia; group portals often list SI roles that never appear on the local site.

coverage_gaps.description: No events run by card schemes and processors active in Slovenia (Mastercard Slovenija, Visa CEE, Bankart, Diners Club Slovenija) or by fintech/payments startups were identified, despite Mastercard Slovenija appearing as a WEBSI award winner.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sl+en searches on 'Mastercard Slovenija dogodek/konferenca', 'Visa Slovenija konferenca', 'Diners Club Slovenija', and check LinkedIn event pages of these entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Security/anti-fraud conferences (e.g. Infosek) and retail/commerce conferences (Slovenian retail and e-commerce trade events) where payment-acceptance topics are discussed were not covered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Infosek konferenca program', 'konferenca trgovine Slovenija', 'e-commerce konferenca Slovenija plačila' and add to the registry.

coverage_gaps.description: Past-edition conference microsites (financna-konferenca.si, dpc.delo.si, ZBS posvet pages) are typically overwritten each year; no snapshot strategy was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) backfill step for each conference domain to reconstruct multi-year speaker/agenda time series, and trigger a save-page-now on each fresh crawl.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian coverage is strong for events and awards, but English-language coverage of Slovenian speakers at international events (Sibos, EBAday, Money20/20, EBA) relies on third-party lists; no systematic search of speaker directories by nationality was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a watchlist of Slovenian bank/processor entity names and run it annually against international conference speaker pages and Finextra/Trade Treasury Payments coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn is where Slovenian bank executives most often post about speaking slots and award wins, but it was not assessed here due to access and terms considerations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess legal/ToS feasibility of monitoring public LinkedIn company pages of Slovenian banks and processors for event and award posts; otherwise rely on mirrored press coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: Utilities and telco billers beyond Telekom Slovenije (e.g. A1 Slovenija, Telemach, Elektro distribution companies, water/heating utilities) were not covered; these are among the largest recurring-collection and direct-debit users in the country.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep on 'položnica', 'trajnik / direktna obremenitev', 'e-račun' plus each biller name, and add their press rooms and annual reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Tolling (DARS e-vinjeta, DarsGo) and airport/duty-free acceptance are entirely uncovered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Target dars.si, evinjeta.dars.si, darsgo.si and Fraport Slovenija press rooms with Slovenian-language queries on 'plačilo', 'plačilna kartica', 'nakup e-vinjete'.

coverage_gaps.description: Hospitality, fuel-adjacent and QSR acceptance (hotels, restaurant chains, tourism operators) is not represented, although these are heavy tip/tourist-card acceptance segments in a tourism-dependent economy.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Turistična zveza / Slovenian Tourist Board and major hospitality groups; search 'gostinci plačevanje s kartico provizija' and 'turistični ponudniki brezstično plačevanje'.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin: only one English query was run and it returned mostly non-Slovenian vendor and market-overview material rather than merchant primary sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run English queries against the /en/ mirrors of the merchant sites identified here (petrol.eu/en, spar.si English pages, telekom.si English IR) to capture the versions aimed at foreign investors, which often differ in detail.

coverage_gaps.description: Merchant-side acquirer and PSP relationships are almost never disclosed publicly; only Big Bang's marketplace seller terms (naming Mangopay) exposed one directly in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically harvest merchant 'pogoji poslovanja' and checkout pages, and inspect public procurement notices (e-narocanje / JN portal) where state-owned merchants such as Pošta Slovenije, LPP and Slovenske železnice must tender for acquiring and POS services.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed public register of DPA fines/decisions naming Slovenian banks or payment providers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check EDPB national-decision pages and the GDPR Enforcement Tracker for Slovenian bank entries; prepare a standing ZDIJZ FOI template for IP-RS inspection decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Addiko and DBS notice pages were located in this pass; equivalent 'obvestila' pages for NLB, OTP, SKB, Nova KBM legacy brands, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica, BKS, Intesa Sanpaolo, Gorenjska banka and non-bank PSPs (Bankart, Moneta/Mobilna denarnica, Flik participants) were not individually enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the Banka Slovenije register of supervised entities (https://www.bsi.si/sl/nadzor-bancnega-sistema/register-subjektov-nadzora) and derive one notice-page URL per institution.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer-complaint community channels (Slo-Tech forum, Reddit r/Slovenia, Facebook groups, Google/Trustpilot reviews of bank apps, App Store/Google Play review streams) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over app-store review feeds and Slo-Tech/Reddit threads for outage and fraud complaint chatter; app-store reviews are the most structured of these.

coverage_gaps.description: ATVP (securities market agency) complaint channel and the Ministry of Economy consumer advisory line / VOP (vsedrzavna) consumer portal were identified only indirectly and not fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ATVP and gov.si consumer-protection pages as candidates in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: sodnapraksa.si was confirmed to contain banking/payment consumer rulings, but no systematic query set or result-volume estimate was built for terms such as 'neodobrena plačilna transakcija', 'zloraba plačilne kartice', 'ZPlaSSIED'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test a Slovene query set against the sodnapraksa.si search parameters and record hit counts per term to size the collection job.

coverage_gaps.description: SEOnet per-issuer deep link and scraping mechanics unresolved for the statutory Slovenian disclosure venue.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a dedicated browser-automation pass on seonet.ljse.si to capture the NLB issuer filter URL/POST parameters and the AttachmentID download pattern.

coverage_gaps.description: London GDR regulatory-news stream (RNS) not pinned to a canonical URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the LSE instrument page for NLB GDRs and the Investegate issuer index; set both up as parallel monitors with dedup by announcement title/date.

coverage_gaps.description: Webcast/Q&A content is audio-visual only; no text pipeline defined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an ASR + speaker-diarisation step for quarterly results webcasts and Investor Day replays, storing timestamped transcripts.

coverage_gaps.description: The ~10 sell-side brokers covering NLB are named on the analyst-coverage page but their individual research/publication channels were not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up discovery pass keyed on the broker names listed on /investor-relations/analyst-coverage to find their public Slovenia/SEE banking research outputs.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-2019 disclosures (pre-IPO and IPO-period material) are partly on legacy nlb.si paths and were only sampled, not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Back-fill via site-restricted search on nlb.si plus web-archive snapshots of the pre-migration investor pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Cell coverage is sl+en only; NLB Group also publishes a Serbian locale (sr) on the media centre, and subsidiary banks disclose locally in SEE languages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If SEE-expansion intelligence is a priority, add the sr locale and subsidiary-bank IR pages as a separate cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Addiko's listed parent was worked through. The IR/segment surfaces of OTP Bank Nyrt. (Budapest), Intesa Sanpaolo / Privredna banka Zagreb, UniCredit S.p.A., Erste Group / Steiermärkische Sparkasse, and AIK banka / Agri Europe Cyprus were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated parent-IR sweep: for each parent, locate the quarterly results presentation and the country/segment appendix where Slovenia appears, plus the parent's own press room for Slovenia-specific announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group disclosure for these subsidiaries is often published first in Hungarian (OTP), Italian (Intesa, UniCredit) or German (Erste/Steiermärkische), and Serbian for AIK. This pass used only sl and en, per run scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag to the run owner whether the language scope should be widened for parent-side sources; if not, accept a lag on parent announcements and rely on the English IR versions.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed, sitemap, or API was confirmed for any press room in this cell; several sites are WordPress (gbkr.si, phv.si) where a /feed/ endpoint is plausible but unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic pass probe /feed/, /rss, and /sitemap.xml on each issuer domain to convert listing-page scraping into feed subscription where possible.

coverage_gaps.description: Hranilnica LON d.d. Kranj was named in the ZBS membership list but no dedicated search hit was obtained for its reports/disclosures page in this pass; the cell's 'savings banks' scope is therefore incomplete.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted local-language search for 'Hranilnica LON letno poročilo razkritja' and its own domain; add to the actor map alongside Delavska hranilnica and Primorska hranilnica Vipava.

coverage_gaps.description: AJPES JOLP documentation states online access covers only the last five years, with older reports obtainable only at AJPES offices; several issuer sites (gbkr.si, phv.si) host older PDFs under dated upload paths with no visible index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prioritise a one-off deep archival snapshot of issuer PDF directories now, and treat AJPES as a rolling 5-year window rather than a historical archive.

coverage_gaps.description: Only OTP banka's dedicated ESG/trajnostno poročanje page was identified; CSRD/sustainability statements for the other entities were not systematically located, and Delavska hranilnica's sustainability disclosure is noted as voluntary and limited in scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sl-language sweep on 'trajnostno poročilo', 'poročilo o trajnostnosti', 'nefinančno poročilo' across all cell entities, since CSRD phase-in will make these a growing disclosure surface.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian ATM/POS terminal estate operators and independent ATM deployers (e.g. bank-shared ATM networks) were not investigated; the cell focused on card processing and instant payments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run local-language queries on 'bankomatska mreža', 'skupna mreža bankomatov', 'POS terminali najem' to identify terminal-estate actors and any shared-ATM joint ventures.

coverage_gaps.description: Fintech/PSP-licensed non-bank acquirers and payment institutions registered with Banka Slovenije were not enumerated, nor was the public register of payment institutions and e-money institutions retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the Banka Slovenije public register of payment institutions / e-money institutions ('register plačilnih institucij', 'družbe za izdajo elektronskega denarja') and treat each entrant as a candidate actor.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurement and tender records were not searched. Bankart and the banks procure processing, HSM, terminal and gateway technology via tenders that reveal vendor selections ahead of any announcement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search the Slovenian public procurement portal (eJN / Portal javnih naročil) and TED for payment-processing, POS terminal and card-personalisation lots, if the buyers fall within scope of procurement law.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth is weak: Bankart annual reports were only located for FY2019 and FY2020, and its newsroom archive appears truncated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve FY2021-FY2025 filings via AJPES JOLP and probe the Internet Archive for older bankart.si newsroom snapshots to rebuild a time series.

coverage_gaps.description: Bankart and flik.si were assessed mainly through Slovenian content; the extent and freshness of their English-language trees (relevant for pan-European counterpart monitoring) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check for /en/ mirrors on bankart.si and flik.si and record whether English content lags the Slovenian original, so collection is anchored on the authoritative language.

coverage_gaps.description: Worldline's and Nexi's Slovenian legal entities (if any beyond Nexi Slovenija d.o.o.) and their local filings were not resolved; only group-level newsrooms were captured for Worldline.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query the AJPES business register for Worldline-, Nets-, Six/Payone- and PayTen/Monri-affiliated entities registered in Slovenia to complete the local operator map.

coverage_gaps.description: The licensed Slovenian PI/EMI population was not enumerated entity-by-entity in this pass; only Paywiser was confirmed by name from the Banka Slovenije register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse the Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register and the EBA PSD2 register filtered to SI to build the complete PI/EMI actor list, then scout a source channel per entity.

coverage_gaps.description: BNPL and wallet startups beyond Leanpay and Paywiser are not mapped; no systematic Slovenian-language sweep was done for terms such as 'digitalna denarnica', 'obročno plačevanje', 'plačaj kasneje'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated Slovenian-language sweep on wallet/BNPL vocabulary plus the startup.si startup-mapa directory and the Ministry of Economy consumer-credit licence register.

coverage_gaps.description: Domestic payment infrastructure/processing vendors adjacent to this cell (Bankart, Halcom, and the Flik instant-payment scheme) were surfaced only incidentally and have no scouted source entries here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Bankart, Halcom and Flik corporate news pages and Banka Slovenije scheme documentation as a separate infrastructure sub-cell, to avoid overlap with the bank-focused cells.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovenian press-release wire (e.g. STA / STA Servis or a PR distribution service used by local fintechs) was scouted, although STA appeared in results as the national news agency.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess STA and any Slovenian PR-distribution wires for a licensed or public feed that would give complete, dated press-release capture for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The single most valuable financial-disclosure source (AJPES JOLP) is behind a free registration wall, and two key media sources (Bloomberg Adria, Delo) are partially paywalled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide on an access approach: register an institutional AJPES account for filings, and limit media collection to headline/date/URL metadata plus short attributed quotes.

coverage_gaps.description: Several seed and adjacent vendors were not yet resolved to concrete, trackable source URLs: Result d.o.o., Endava's Slovenian banking work, ZZI d.o.o. (e-invoicing/EDI), Marand, Špica, Datalab, SRC d.o.o. and Actual I.T./Unistar own reference pages, and Iskratel/S&T-Kontron.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an AJPES/Bizi entity-resolution pass over the candidate vendor names, then fetch each vendor's own /reference, /aktualno, /novice and /primeri-uporabe pages directly rather than relying on search engines.

coverage_gaps.description: Card/POS acquiring technology suppliers to Slovenian merchants and banks (Printec, Payten Slovenia local entity, Nexi/Nets, Worldline, PayTech resellers, Petrol/Mercator POS estates) were not covered; the sl seed query on POS terminals returned foreign-bank pages instead.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated sl+en pass using terms POS terminal, plačilni terminal, sprejemanje kartic, ponudnik POS, kartično sprejemanje za trgovce, plus site: queries on merchant/acquirer domains and Bankart's acquiring pages.

coverage_gaps.description: For several high-value vendor sites the exact news/reference index URL is a hypothesis rather than an observed path (Halcom news index, Comtrade case-study index, Payten clients page, Euronet SI pages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each domain's /sitemap.xml and robots.txt to enumerate real section paths before configuring monitors; record observed paths in the registry.

coverage_gaps.description: The HRC 'Aktualno' index was read but publication dates were not visible in the extracted content, so the Hibis implementations (Deželna banka, OTP, Nova KBM, Croatian euro transition) currently lack reliable dating.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch individual HRC article pages and parse dates from metadata (JSON-LD/og:published_time) or the page body; cross-date against bank annual reports and Wayback Machine first-capture dates.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor reference and news pages are routinely rewritten when a customer is lost or a brand changes (HRC itself announced a new brand identity), so today's snapshot loses history.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically pull Wayback Machine CDX histories for hrc.si, halcom.com, mikrografija.com, comtradeintegration.com and bankart.si to reconstruct the customer-list timeline and detect silent removals.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage of vendors serving Slovenian banks from neighbouring markets (HR, RS, AT, IT) was not attempted in those languages, although HRC explicitly operates in Croatia and Comtrade is Belgrade-headquartered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the query set into hr and sr (jezgreni bankarski sistem, dobavljač bankarskog softvera, reference banke) and de/it for Austrian/Italian parent-group suppliers, filtering for Slovenian bank mentions.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed programmatic search/API path for enarocanje.si notices; only individual form-id URLs and a general terms PDF were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect the portal's own search form and the Uradni list PJN2 subdomain for query parameters or an export; read the Splošni pogoji PDF for scraping constraints before building a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV code set for banking, payment services, payment terminals and financial-sector IT was not enumerated in this pass, yet all portal/TED filtering depends on it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit CPV allowlist (66100000 banking and investment services, 66500000 insurance/pension, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30144200/30162000/48xxxxxx equipment and software) and validate it against a sample of known Slovenian award notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Some state-linked financial actors in scope were not individually researched: Kapitalska družba (KAD/Modra zavarovalnica), Zavarovalnica Triglav's state-linked ownership, Slovenski regionalno razvojni sklad, Javni štipendijski sklad, and municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate finance-sector contracting authorities from the e-uprava institution directory and AJPES, then run each as a naročnik query against enarocanje.si, TED and Erar.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature — award notices, DKOM decisions, Court of Audit reports and SDH/SID reports are predominantly Slovenian, with only partial English versions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Slovenian-language extraction and translation in the pipeline; use TED's bilingual notices as the main English-side cross-reference.

coverage_gaps.description: No backfill route confirmed for pre-2018 Slovenian award notices (e-JN open dataset starts April 2018).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate TED bulk XML archives and the OpenTender/OCDS publication for pre-2018 Slovenian coverage; document the earliest reliable date per source.

coverage_gaps.description: ZBS committees/working groups ('odbori', 'delovne skupine', e.g. for payment systems, cards, AML) were not enumerated; the Organiziranost page was located but not read in detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.zbs-giz.si/organiziranost/ and extract committee names, chairs and member institutions — the sharpest map of who drives SI payments infrastructure decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Bančni vestnik article-level index (issue TOCs, authors, abstracts) not harvested; the legacy archive host info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv was referenced only via search results and not fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt a direct fetch of the e-arhiv issue index pages to determine whether TOC/abstract layers are open; if closed, pursue COBISS/NUK article-level search or an institutional subscription.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was identified covering payment institutions, e-money institutions or card processors specifically (e.g. no SI counterpart to a national PSP association); Bankart-type scheme/processor bodies were not found in an association context in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search in Slovene for 'plačilna institucija', 'družba za izdajo elektronskega denarja', 'procesiranje kartic' combined with 'združenje'/'zbornica', and check whether processors participate through ZBS committees instead.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional chambers (GZS regional units) and the crafts chamber OZS (Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije) were not searched; OZS represents small merchants who are heavy POS/card-acceptance users.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl queries for 'Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije POS terminali provizije' and enumerate GZS regional chamber news feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Association conference and event proceedings (e.g. ZBS/Bančni vestnik annual banking conferences, 'Dan slovenskega bančništva'-type events) were not directly located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query sl for ZBS konferenca / posvet / 'Dan slovenskega bančništva' and crawl https://www.zbs-giz.si/ogled-dogodkov/ for agendas and speaker decks.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association coverage is thin by nature — only the ZBS EN mirror, AmCham and SBCA were found in English; most substantive material exists only in Slovene.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Slovene as the mandatory working language for this cell; budget for sl-language NLP/translation in the collector rather than relying on EN mirrors.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found yet for the Primorska/coastal and Gorenjska regional press (e.g. Primorske novice, Gorenjski glas), which would carry local branch closures, savings-bank (hranilnica) news and regional employer/bank disputes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Slovene queries such as 'Primorske novice banka hranilnica poslovalnica' and 'Gorenjski glas banka' and add confirmed regional titles.

coverage_gaps.description: No investigative/long-form outlet identified (e.g. Necenzurirano, Pod črto, Mladina, Reporter). These are where bank-governance scandals, NPL disposals and political pressure on state-linked banks typically break, and they are absent from the seed list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Necenzurirano banka', 'Pod črto bančna sanacija', 'Mladina banke' and classify as direct investigative sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Journalist- and analyst-level channels (bylines, LinkedIn/X accounts of Finance.si and Delo banking reporters, podcast/newsletter formats) were not enumerated; these often carry the earliest, pre-publication signals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a byline map from banking articles at Finance.si, Delo and Svet kapitala, then track those journalists' own channels.

coverage_gaps.description: No press-archive or clipping aggregator confirmed for Slovenia (Digitalna knjižnica Slovenije/dLib, Kliping d.o.o., or the skupaj.si clipping pages seen in results), which would enable retrospective baselining rather than forward-only monitoring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate dLib.si for digitised press, and assess commercial clipping vendors for licensed archive access to Finance/Delo/Dnevnik/Večer.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language Slovenian outlets (STA English service, Total Slovenia News, Sloveniatimes) were not enumerated in this pass, though the cell is nominally SL-focused.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add STA's English wire and one or two English Slovenian outlets as cross-check surfaces for items whose Slovene originals are paywalled.

briefs: Slovenia's supervisory disclosure layer is concentrated in three publishers: Banka Slovenije (banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, payment-system oversight and payment statistics), ATVP (issuers, investment firms, prospectuses, and the OAM regulated-information repository), and AZN (insurers, pension companies, and the distribution register). Banka Slovenije is by far the richest and most collectable: an open, well-structured site with a filterable announcements hub, a publications catalogue with an advance release calendar, statutory supervisory disclosures, a named-entity enforcement list, and registers that together form the canonical actor map for both banking and payments; its English mirror covers publications and statistics but not everything. ATVP holds the highest-value annual-report and issuer-disclosure material (OAM, ESEF filings, enforcement measures) but its domain returned 403 to a plain fetch, so it should be treated as bot-defended-but-live and approached with a headless browser rather than written off. Slovenian-language terminology is mandatory throughout - nadzorniška razkritja, izrečeni ukrepi, register subjektov nadzora, nadzorovani subjekti, letno poročilo - since ATVP and AZN publish essentially only in Slovenian; the main remaining gaps are the EU-level layer (ECB/SSM, EBA, ESMA registers filtered to SI), the AML office and Ministry of Finance, and any structured/SDMX data endpoint behind the payment statistics.

Slovenia's disclosure infrastructure is unusually centralised: AJPES is the single statutory sink for essentially all corporate annual reports (JOLP), the business and court registers, and official corporate/insolvency announcements (eObjave), while LJSE's SEOnet is the mandated venue for listed-issuer regulated information, backed by the INFO HRAMBA storage mechanism and mirrored on the regulator side by ATVP's registers and the referenced oam.si. For A1 this means two primary ingestion points (AJPES for the unlisted majority, SEOnet for NLB and the handful of listed financial issuers), plus three pointer registers — ePRS/OPSI for SKD-coded entity discovery and Banka Slovenije's register subjektov nadzora for the licensed bank/payment-institution universe. The main constraints are commercial and technical rather than legal: free JOLP access is rate-limited and five years deep, scalable structured financials sit behind the paid FI-PO/ponovna-uporaba tariff, and no public API or RSS was found for SEOnet, so disclosure ingestion will likely need a maintained HTML crawler.

The English-language layer over Slovenian banking and payments is thin, commercial and concentrated: STA's English service is the upstream translator, and SeeNews plus bne IntelliNews are the two regional wires that actually carry Slovenian bank results, M&A and ratings for an investor audience — all three are subscription-gated, with free restatement available mainly via The Slovenia Times and Total Slovenia News. Genuine English primary material does exist and should be preferred: NLB's int-en investor-relations and press-release streams, its LSE/RNS filings mirrored free on Investegate, the LJSE SEOnet English interface, and Banka Slovenije's fully translated Financial Stability Reports and payments pages. For payments specifically the EU trade layer (Finextra, The Paypers, FinTech Futures, European Payments Council) carries Bankart/Flik infrastructure news that domestic general press covers only in Slovenian. The decisive constraint found in this pass is that SEOnet states only the Slovene text has legal value and NLB's Slovenian investor-news pages have no guaranteed English twin, so the English layer must be treated as a discovery and cross-check channel over a Slovenian-primary collection design, never as a substitute for it.

Third-party assessment of Slovenian banks splits cleanly into three tiers. Tier one is EU supervisory and resolution data — EBA transparency exercise and the new EDAP portal, ECB Supervisory Banking Statistics (Slovenia is an explicit SI country dimension, repeatedly the EU's highest net interest margin), SRB MREL outputs and IMF Article IV — all open, machine-readable and the backbone of any Slovenia bank benchmark. Tier two is the rating agencies (Moody's, S&P/BICRA, Fitch, plus Scope and DBRS on the sovereign): rich and forward-looking but largely paywalled, so in practice they are collected through issuer IR mirrors (NLB Group ratings page, OTP banka ratings page) and Slovenian/regional media (RTV SLO's 'bonitetna ocena' archive, SeeNews). Tier three is the audit and consultancy layer: no Slovenia-specific Big Four banking study appears to exist, so Slovenia is best tracked as a country line in Deloitte's CEE Banking M&A Study and Raiffeisen Research's CEE Banking Sector Report, while the audit angle is best worked through the regulator ANR's public registers and oversight decisions plus Big Four transparency reports. Priority follow-ups are the auditor-to-bank mapping and ICT/operational-risk supervisory outputs, neither of which this pass covered.

Slovenia's hiring-signal landscape for banking and payments rests on three layers: a small set of general SI job portals (MojeDelo, Optius, Zaposlitev.net) plus the state ZRSZ/ESS vacancy register, which together give near-complete but shallow coverage; employer-owned careers pages (NLB, OTP, Intesa Sanpaolo, Deželna banka) and — most valuable — the shared infrastructure and vendor players Bankart and Halcom, whose ads name the exact payment platforms and programmes being stood up sector-wide; and LinkedIn, which carries the richest stack and seniority detail but is login- and ToS-restricted, so it needs manual or licensed access rather than scraping. Optius is the best structured entry point because it exposes stable per-employer URLs for most Slovenian banks, and BetterCareer.si adds IT-specific depth. The dominant operational risk is ephemerality: ads are deleted on expiry and no public archive of past Slovenian bank vacancies was found, so all value depends on capturing and timestamping ad text at first sighting. Language-wise, SL framing words (prosta delovna mesta, zaposlitev, kariera, plačilni promet) must be combined with English technical tokens, which SI bank IT ads use verbatim.

Slovenia's banking-events landscape is unusually centralised: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) is both the convener (spring bančna konferenca, the annual Dan slovenskih bančnikov, and a dozen recurring posveti including card business, payment services and IT) and the publisher of record via Bančni vestnik, its news page and its YouTube recordings. Outside ZBS, the durable venues are the ICT conference Dnevi slovenske informatike with its published zbornik, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange/Finance 'Finančna konferenca', Delo's payments-flavoured Mobilne tehnologije conference, and the regional CEE stage Money Motion in Zagreb where Slovenian fintech and bank executives regularly speak. Awards function as self-declared disclosure: WEBSI digital-project shortlists, Moje finance 'naj/najugodnejša banka' rankings, and Global Finance / Euromoney country winners, all of which banks amplify on their own /nagrade pages.
